reviewer: Pickle: official-source insulated tumbler/thermos comparison and cleaning guide
method: Reviewed the full draft against 14 source URLs, all returning HTTP 200 on 2026-11-03. Seoul YWCA tumbler quality comparison (2024-03-05, FTC consumer-group cooperation project, official YWCA release + Power Economy numeric detail + Yonhap photo report): 8 brands, 13 products (5 semi-sealed, 8 fully-sealed, stainless 450-500 ml), heat retention measured 24 h after 95 C water and cold retention 24 h after 4 C water, following KS G 3200:2017 and eco-label EL333:2022; Thermos Carry Loop best overall, fully-sealed beat semi-sealed, sealed-group spread up to 17.3 C; 24 h hot 31.3-48.6 C (sealed) vs 22.5-26.2 C (semi), cold 12.8-16.8 vs 19.3-20.3 C; weight 236 g (Thermos) to 346 g (Stanley, 110 g spread); mouth diameter 50-66 mm sealed vs 78-86 mm semi (36 mm / 1.7x spread); no leaks when laid down for 8 sealed, 3 semi-sealed leaked within the 50 ml limit; surface temperature rise 4.0-5.2 K within standard; user ratings sealing 4.0 > grip 3.8 > condensation 3.6 > portability 3.5 = washability 3.5; capacity marking 95%+ compliant for all. Abrasive residue: detected before washing in 6 products, absent in all after neutral-detergent wipe plus food-oil-soaked paper towel rubbing. MFDS (식약처) press release 2021-01-31 (impfood.mfds.go.kr official + Yonhap): new stainless products may retain abrasive; wipe with food oil on paper towel, then boil with vinegar-added water for 10 minutes; stains with diluted vinegar; dry fully before storage; rust removed with metal cleaner; acid/salty foods damage the surface in long storage. Health Chosun 2022-01-21: abrasive main component silicon carbide, IARC Group 2A probable carcinogen, hydrophobic so water/detergent fail, oil + baking soda + vinegar methods. KCA (한국소비자원) 2012 12-bottle test (Financial News + Medical Today + Munhwa): 95 C into 20 C room for 6 h; Zojirushi/Thermos/Apollo/Cosmos above 80 C 'excellent', HotnCool/Igloo/Blackstone/New Optimma 79-73 C, Stencala/Legend/Fairmug/Tesco below 72 C; price spread up to 2.7x (Igloo 9,900 vs New Optimma 27,000), Zojirushi lightest 282 g, Apollo heaviest 373 g, no performance-marking requirement noted. Shokaken (Japanese accredited lab) JIS S 2006 heat-retention table: portable stainless 0.4-0.6 L at 20 C for 6 h, inner-mouth diameter under 39 mm needs 70 C+, 39-54 mm 68 C+, 54 mm+ 66 C+. KSA standard page KS G 3200 'Stainless steel vacuum bottles' (issued 2017-12-26, notice 2017-0631, confirmed 2022-08-25); glass bottles are KS L 2407 — the plan's 'KS L 2406' was corrected to the actual standards in effect. KAERI nuclear-materials portal: stainless needs 11%+ Cr for the passive Cr2O3 film, Type 304 = 18Cr-8Ni, Type 316 adds 2-3% Mo for pitting resistance, carbon 0.08% max (L grade 0.03%); Kaizen Alloys composition/PREN table: 304 Cr 18-20/Ni 8-10.5, 316 Cr 16-18/Ni 10-14/Mo 2-3, PREN 19 vs 25, chloride environments favor 316 while potable water/food uses 304 — so a 304 tumbler is the standard choice, not a defect. Health Chosun 2026-07-16 (Purdue University 90-bottle study): exteriors failed ATP cleanliness, many interiors exceeded the 100-500 CFU/mL reference, coliform detected in some, coffee/latte/protein drinks worsen contamination, biofilm on lid gaskets and straws resists rinsing; care: neutral detergent or baking soda with 60 C+ hot water, disassemble lid/gasket/straw at least 2-3 times a week with bottle and straw brushes, assemble only when fully dry, replace on smell/discoloration/damaged gasket. Busan Buk-gu office 2018 tip: baking soda 2-3 spoons for 20-30 minutes, vinegar 1 spoon for 20-30 minutes, do not shake with hot drinks or carbonated drinks inside (internal pressure explosion risk), dry completely. Coupang verification: all three ranked products opened in-browser on 2026-11-03 with prices, review counts, and rocket delivery confirmed (Thermos New Daily One-touch JNL-505K black 500 ml product 9117867464 — 28,620 won, 37% off, 3,395 reviews; Stanley Quencher H2.0 FlowState Rose Quartz 2.0 product 6792297030 — 42,480 won 887 ml, 13% off, 48,637 reviews; Zojirushi SM-TA60 white 600 ml product 146784032 — 36,900 won, 25% off, 909 reviews), and the three freshly issued partner deep links redirect to the correct product IDs with lptag=AF6593875. Kakao Gift curator links issued under the user's curator account (9% commission), verified by capturing the copy payload and HTTP 200: Cennai Paris classic tumbler 500 ml + straw set (6 colors) 29,800 won / max 28,800 won → gift-link.kakao.com/c/vnEnJNFu; Osulloc Premium Tea Collection 25,600 won → gift-link.kakao.com/c/bFGXVyDC. Plan deviations: (1) the plan's '한국표준협회 KS L 2406' does not match any thermos standard in the KSA catalog — the stainless vacuum bottle standard is KS G 3200 (used by the YWCA test) and glass vacuum bottles are KS L 2407, so the body cites those; (2) the plan's '한국소비자원 보온 효력 6시간 68~72℃ 유지' is grounded as: the KCA 2012 test measured 6 h retention of 95 C water (80 C+ top grade), and the 66-70 C @6 h figures come from the JIS S 2006 table (0.4-0.6 L by inner-mouth diameter), not a single KCA number; (3) the plan's gift-product suggestion (Thermos/Stanley gift sets) was replaced by the two curator products whose links the curator dashboard actually issues (Cennai Paris tumbler set — directly on-topic — and Osulloc tea collection); the Thermos JNL-505K is covered by the Coupang ranking card instead.
